text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking down the hallway—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Tran, you can already do a full 
run-through!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, even I'm surprised~ Talk about 
unlocking an unexpected talent!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I won't... I won't lose either!! I'm gonna 
run through the dance from the top one 
more time!!

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Natural talent... Even though we're in the 
same class taking the same lessons, 
there's this much of a gap.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"To think she is so beloved by the god of 
dance... —Heh, I'm almost jealous."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Tran-chan is all smiles. Praise me 
even more, please~♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Argh! Don't get so cocky! I'll be able to 
dance it in no time too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Transcend seems to be an exceptionally 
good dancer among her classmates, even 
while taking the exact same lessons.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list:
...I knew it, you were doing solo 
training.

...I knew it, you were doing solo 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she speaks lightly, she's serious 
at heart. "My sense blossomed"— I figured 
there was more behind those words.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: What's all this, it's just Trainy-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Wait, what do you mean, 'as expected'—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... ...Did you see me in class 
earlier?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No, no, observing class is totally 
normal, right? I meant your deduction 
skills are seriously insane.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Just as you figured, Train-chan. I 
was doing some secret training~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...So. You didn't come here just for 
nothing, right?"
choice_data_list:
I thought there might be some training you 
can't do on your own.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. Could it be that you're gonna dance 
with me?
choice_data_list:
...I mean, if you're fine with someone 
like me...

...If you're fine with someone like me, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, don't get cold feet now~ I'm 
counting on ya!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, what should we dance? Since you're 
tagging along, I'll match your pace, 
Trainy~
choice_data_list: Let's go with your favorite song.
Let's go with a song I'm bad at!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
So, what should we dance? Since you're 
tagging along, I'll match your pace, 
Trainy~
choice_data_list: Let's go with your favorite song.
Let's go with a song I'm bad at!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oho~? ...So you said that knowing full 
well what I like? ♡

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Lookin' good, Trainer! We're gonna 
turn it up even more, 'kay~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Haha! Well of course! There's no holding 
back when it's this much fun!!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
choice_data_list:
It's independent training to overcome your 
weaknesses, right?

It's voluntary training to overcome your 
weaknesses, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ............Stop with the sound logic.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, at first I was like, 'This guy...' 
but...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan's cute dance was totally 
great♡

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Thanks a bunch~. Now I feel like I 
can dance to anything with a big smile!
